# FastAPI CRUD Template

Gerado via AI Provider OS Workplace Templates

## Run
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

## Endpoints
- POST /items/ - Create
- GET /items/ - List
- GET /items/{id} - Get
- PUT /items/{id} - Update
- DELETE /items/{id} - Delete
